dedupe_keys.name: windeee downburst measurement processing matlab scripts

description: The WindEEE Dome researchers publish three MATLAB scripts for preparing repeated impinging-jet wind measurements. The separate Figshare deposit is CC BY 4.0 and lists alignment, saving and dataset-writing scripts. The article says the work used MATLAB R2017b and a manufacturer library for part of the probe processing. This code can help reproduce the synchronization of repeated velocity signals before using them to validate downburst wind exposure models for buildings or lines. Its example covers the WindEEE Dome experiment. A caveat is that the manufacturer library and original measurement environment may be required to rerun every step; the Figshare file list alone does not establish a complete standalone application. The scripts prepare laboratory data, not simulate a weather event. I read the own Figshare metadata, file names and article code statement without downloading or executing MATLAB files, checking numerical alignment or testing newer MATLAB versions. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
